**v1.6.0**:

**New Features:**
- Safari Timer: Shows elapsed time in current run.
- Wumpa Spawn Progress: Counts unique mobs for Wumpa to spawn.
- Hideon Higlighter: Highlights Hideonwall, Hideonfloor, Hideonsun, etc., basically all mobs in the Hideon family.
- Duplico Highlighter: Highlights duplico, also higlights rockmite mounds accidentally since they are the same entity type.

**Other Additions:**
- Added support for Tree Gift Confirmation to show the new mob spawns in Torrhus Canyon from the trees.
- Added Streak amount to the Tree Gifts Per Hour display, which displays Tree Gifts gained without at least 1-minute of downtime.
- Added Sneak override for Block Incorrect Clicks in Arrow Alignment Solver.

**Bug Fixes:**
- Fixed Tree Gifts Per Hour not working in Torrhus Canyon.
- Fixed Tree Gift Confirmation not working in Torrhus Canyon.
- Fixed Enforce Zorro's Cape not being automatically disabled while in Torrhus Canyon.

**Updated Requirements:**
- Mod now requires Fabric API 0.155.2 or later.

releases.notes:
**v1.5.0**:

**New:**
- Auto LB Release: Releases right click automatically every 400 milliseconds when you are holding it down when using a Last Breath for optimal arrow stack when debuffing.
- Open Equipment Menu when Cooldown Over or Pests Spawned: Opens Equipment Menu by sending /eq command automatically when your Pest Cooldown is over, and opens it again once you spawn some pests. Useful if swapping between Pest Equipment and regular Farming equipment.
- Section Done Display: Shows on screen how many sections of Phase 3 has been done so far, shows yellow for first 2, green when section 3 is done so that you can re-core safely when it turns green and people leap.
- No Explosion Particles: Removes explosion particles fully, preventing them from spawning at all. This does not only hide them but also removes them, which should also improve performance a bit if lot of explosions are happening.
- Cache GL Calls: Caches a few GL calls such as glScissor and glPolygonMode if the parameters have not been changed since last frame to improve performance slightly by saving a JNI call and a GL call.
- Added an outdated version toast when update checker is enabled in addition to the chat message for more visibility.
- Disable GL Debug: Disables GL debug when creating GL device in GlBackend codepath, the parameter passed to GpuDebugOption. This usually removes the debug error messages if any error happens and thus might improve performance.

**Removed:**
- Removed Fix CTRL and ALT on Wayland feature as the bug was fixed in vanilla 26.1.

**Changed:**
- Sound threads now have a higher priority in Thread Priority Tweaker.
- Enhanced safety of Auto Fishing Rod feature.

**Updated Requirements:**
- Mod now requires Fabric API 0.154.0 or later.

releases.notes:
**v1.4.0:**

**Higlight:**
- Updated the mod to 26.1.2

This release still has a jar for 1.21.11 that has everything working, but this might not be the case for future. Please consider upgrading and using the 26.1.2 version, as going forward that will be the main development target.

**Please make sure to download the jar that is for your game version. darkutils-1.4.0+1.21.11.jar for 1.21.11, and darkutils-1.4.0+26.1.2.jar for 26.1.2 version.** The 1.21.11 and 26.1.2 versions are incompatible as the updates are not just a patch update.

**v1.4.0:**

**Attention:**
- This release only supports Minecraft 1.21.11 and 26.1.2. If you are still on 1.21.10, stick to the v1.3.0 version.

**New:**
- Added support for Minecraft 26.1.2.

- Corpses Per Shaft Display: Shows corpse statistics like % of found and opened corpses per shaft. Amount of shafts and opened corpses are automatically tracked when enabled.
- Mineshaft Display: Shows mineshaft information like time passed since last shaft spawn, avg time between shaft spawns, despawn timer when a shaft spawns before you enter it, after entering shows uptime (how long have you been in the shaft) and warp close time (time till you can warp others) instead.
- Will O Wisp Display: Shows time remaining on your Will-o'-wisp, or INACTIVE if it is out of radius or has expired. Takes account for the 30 block radius when outside a shaft, which is infinite radius inside a shaft.
- Littlefoot Display: Shows a list of Littlefoot entities nametags in your screen, allowing you to see whether any littlefoots remain in current shaft, or if there were none, along with their health.
- Pickaxe Ability Display: Shows a timer of remaining time for your Pickaxe Ability on screen.
- Auto Clicker Half AOTV CPS: Makes Auto Clicker work at half its normal click rate when holding AOTV when Auto Clicker Work With AOTV is enabled. It will click with 10 CPS instead of the normal 20.
- Prefer Wayland: Prefers Wayland over XWayland when running a Wayland session in Linux systems when your GLFW version supports the native Wayland backend. This generally improves performance as it doesn't have to go through XWayland compatibility layer. Does nothing in Windows or macOS, or when running a X11 only session/old GLFW without native Wayland support.
- Fix Ctrl and Alt on Wayland: Fixes a bug where CTRL and ALT is inserted as a character in chat when trying to for example select all text with CTRL + A. This not needed if running through XWayland, X11, or in Windows/macOS, or with a patched GLFW in Linux. Does nothing if Prefer wayland is not enabled or if you do not have this issue already.
- Fix Game Icon on Wayland: Fixes a bug where Minecraft does not properly set the game icon on modern desktop environments expecting a .desktop file and an icon at ~/.local/share/applications while running on Linux Wayland environment. Does nothing if Prefer Wayland is not enabled or when running through XWayland/X11.

**Removed:**
- [26.1.2 Only] Removed the Disable Yield feature as Mojang has now removed the yielding themselves in the base game.
- Removed the Viewport Cache feature as Sodium now provides it, this was included only because I thought the PR wouldn't be merged to Sodium.
- Removed the Disable Chat Scrollbar feature as the scrollbar is actually useful to know if you are viewing past messages or not, and the feature was simply not worth maintaining as it broke on upgrade to 1.21.11 and didn't work anyways.
- Removed the Armor Stand Optimizer feature as it was hiding stuff that might be important such as Kuudra Ballista Building progress or the Garden mutations, while not providing much performance benefit in modern versions. This feature was ported from 1.8 and in that version doubled your FPS in armor stand heavy scenes, but nowadays the rendering is already optimized in vanilla.
 Suboptions such as Armor Stand Limit is also gone.

releases.notes:
**v1.3.0:**

**Higlight:**
- Updated the mod to 1.21.11

This release still has a jar for 1.21.10 that has everything working, but this might not be the case for future. Please consider upgrading and using the 1.21.11 version, as going forward that will be the main development target.

**Please make sure to download the jar that is for your game version. darkutils-1.3.0+1.21.11.jar for 1.21.11, and darkutils-1.3.0+1.21.10.jar for 1.21.10 version.** As mojang have migrated to game drops, the 1.21.11 and 1.21.10 versions are incompatible as the updates are not just a patch update.

**v1.3.0:**

**New**
- Middle Click Fix: Enables use of middle click for example to disable Witherborn armor ability, just like in 1.8.
- Optimize Enum Values: Optimizes memory allocation rate by eliminating enum values array copying in some places, currently only a single place.
- Disable Error Checking Entirely: Overrides glGetError to always return no error to disable error checking completely.
- AC work with AOTV: Makes RC AC work with AOTV, making you teleport and etherwarp faster.
- Blood Cleared Notification: Shows a message on screen when the blood room is cleared with how much time it took for it.
- Dungeon Timer HUD: Displays dungeon timer on left side of the screen, showing time took to finish each phase. Shows live time if not finished yet, and shows how much time is lost to server lag, with fancy item icons, seperate colors, and non-phase informational splits, like Boss Total.
 Includes sub-options: Dungeon Timer Scale, Dungeon Timer Offset X, Dungeon Timer Offset Y.
- Viewport Cache: Caches viewport GL calls if the viewport did not change, improving performance.
- Cursor Pos Wayland GL Error Fix: Fixes a bug where Minecraft tries to call glfwSetCursorPos in Wayland desktop environment, where setting the cursor position is not supported, by cancelling the call. This prevents the GL error while preserving behaviour, as setting the position fails with the GL error anyways.
- Debug Mode: Prints additional details like the full call stack in some code paths for debugging purposes. Might incur a performance penalty. Do not enable unless instructed to do so.
- Solo Crush Waypoint: Renders a waypoint for the block you need to lower the purple crusher into so that it can crush Storm the next time you lower it.
- Enable Mod Announcer: By default, Firmament's Mod Announcer feature is disabled by us, but you can enable it with this option. Note that this degrades your privacy if enabled.
- Pest Cooldown Display: Shows a display with remaining pest cooldown, e.g., time until you can spawn your next pests.
- Persistent Tablist while Farming: Always shows tablist while you are actively farming. Tablist shows useful info while farming in Garden, such as the percentage to the next crop milestone for the crop you are farming, the visitors in your garden, and more.
- Sticky Farming Keys: Turns the keys to move forward, back, left, right and the key to attack into toggle instead of hold whilst you are farming. Note: Only one sticky movement key is active at a time. You must enable them indiviually below. Pressing any movement key will disable other sticky keys even if that movement key's sticky setting is disabled.
- Enforce Zorro's Cape: Enforces having Zorro's Cape equipped before claiming any contest. You might need to open your equipment menu the first time to let the mod know you have it equipped, but after that the mod will remember your last equipped cloak.
- Disable Update Checker: Disables the update checker. This release has a enabled-by-default update checker using the official GitHub API, but we give you the option to opt-out if you want to.

releases.notes:
**v1.2.0:**

**Higlight:**
- Updated the mod to 1.21.10

This release still has a jar for 1.21.8 that has everything working, but this might not be the case for future. Please consider upgrading and using the 1.21.10 version, as going forward that will be the main development target.

**Please make sure to download the jar that is for your game version. darkutils-1.2.0+1.21.10.jar for 1.21.10, and darkutils-1.2.0+1.21.8.jar for 1.21.8 version.** As mojang have migrated to game drops, the 1.21.8 and 1.21.10 versions are incompatible as the latter is not just a patch update.

**New:**
- Disable Useless Block-Hit: Disables useless block-hit when you are holding a sword without an ability. If you right-click on air or on a block that's not an interaction like opening a chest, the right click is handled to simulate the 1.8 blockhit slowdown in Hypixel and can even lag you back. This feature prevents you from rightclicking with a sword that doesn't have an ability and if the click was not on a interaction block or entity/NPC.

- Disable Cells Alignment: Disables using the Cells Alignment ability when right-clicking looking at air or an uninteractable block. The click will still go through but not activate the ability when looking at interactable blocks such as chest, lever, beacon, command block (terminal), etc. The click will also go through when looking at an entity/NPC, which still does not activate the ability.

- Disable Glowing: Disables the glowing effect Hypixel renders on certain entities to improve performance at the cost of no longer being able to see the outline through walls on those entities. Those include:
 Dungeon temmate glow (Hypixel adds rank based glow in Dungeons, for example VIP will be green, MVP will be blue. With this feature it will be turned off)
 Frogs in Galatea (Hypixel glows Frogs white in the galatea. This disables it)
 Dropped items (Hypixel renders dropped items with their rarity color, e.g an epic item in the floor renders as purple. This will disable it.)

- Disable Command Confirmation: Disables Command Confirmation menu that opens when you click on chat to run a command but the command is invalid or unrecognized client-side. This happens when servers forget to send the client all the commands they handle or have registered server-side, or if they use dynamic commands. This does not disable the Command Confirmation menu entirely, notably the confirmation menu when running elevated operator commands still appears.

- Rejoin Cooldown Display: Displays the time you have to wait until you can rejoin SkyBlock after getting kicked while joining a server (changing island).
 A clock item icon is rendered before the cooldown text, exclusive to 1.21 (Rendering API is way simpler in 1.21 so this is not going to get backported to 1.8 version)

- Added an Oak Log item icon to be rendered before the Tree Gifts Per Hour Display text, just like the Rejoin Cooldown Display.

- Laggy Server Detector: Shows 30 second TPS Average 30 seconds after joining/changing servers.

- Sound Lag Fix: Prevents duplicate sounds from being played on the same tick by misbehaving or lagging servers. Only the duplicate sounds are prevented meaning you will still hear all sounds, but without it affecting your performance.

- Thread Priority Tweaker: Improves performance by tweaking priorities of all threads in the background regularly.

- Arrow Stack Waypoints: Displays arrow stack waypoints in the Wither King dragon fight showing where to shoot your Last Breath arrows for optimal stacking.

- Disable Signature Verification: Disables signature verification to improve performance by skipping the verification step, also possibly fixing missing textures in certain servers.

- Block Entity Unload Lag Fix: Fixes vanilla Minecraft bug, where lag occurs when unloading large amount of block entities.

- Item Frame Sound Fix: Fixes vanilla Minecraft bug, where sounds are played when they shouldn't in certain cases near item frames.
